D018.key_difference: Duration of symptoms after exposure to traumatic event

D018: Symptoms experienced after exposure to a traumatic event persist for more than 1 month.
D019: Symptoms experienced after exposure to a traumatic event are limited to a duration of 3 days to 1 month.

D018.additional_condition: Presence of repetitive and intrusive thoughts
D018.key_difference: Association between intrusive thoughts and traumatic event/Presence of compulsive behaviors

D018: Intrusive thoughts are related to the experience of the traumatic event, and compulsive behaviors do not appear.
D016: Intrusive thoughts are unrelated to the traumatic event, and compulsive behaviors appear. Other symptoms of posttraumatic stress disorder are not accompanied.

D018.key_difference: Association between anxiety and traumatic event

D018: Avoidance, irritability, and anxiety are related to the experience of the traumatic event.
D011: Avoidance, irritability, and anxiety appear unrelated to a specific traumatic event.

D018: Depressive symptoms are related to the experience of the traumatic event, and diagnostic criteria for posttraumatic stress disorder are met.
D013: Depressive symptoms may appear after the experience of a traumatic event, but diagnostic criteria for posttraumatic stress disorder are not met.

D018: Attention and concentration problems appear after exposure to the traumatic event.

D018.key_difference: Association between hallucinations and traumatic event, and presence of other psychotic symptoms

D018: Hallucinations are directly related to the traumatic experience (in the form of flashbacks), and other psychotic symptoms are not accompanied.
D005: Hallucinations appear unrelated to the traumatic experience, and other psychotic symptoms are accompanied.
